scope: 42 base catalogue part representations including touring and upholstered door trim, 8 additional lamp representations, market-product mappings
standard: Rendering is not proof of product fidelity. No asset in this audit is a manufacturer-verified exact SKU replica.

evidence.basePhotoReview: All 40 former catalogue images compared with corresponding authored model views. Mixed illustration/product imagery must not be presented as matching SKU renders.
evidence.replacementPreview: assets/previews/part-<id>.webp; generated from the same live renderer and model used when selecting the part

marketMappings: 70 records: 37 generic visual aliases, 2 reference-guided Front Runner Slimline II variants, 31 shortlist-only. The two rack trays use published 1345 x 1964 mm dimensions and eight gutter mounts; mounting height and hardware are approximate. No exact manufacturer CAD claim.
remaining: Manufacturer-grade photorealism is not reached. Base body surface continuity, optical material calibration, detailed interior trim and individually measured/scanned SKU assets still require further asset work. Current improvements must not be described as an exact product configurator.
